name: Privacy-Safe Journey Signals
summary: Adds a privacy-safe public journey signal layer that observes the availability inquiry without storing form content or personal data.
changes: Introduces a reusable in-memory public journey signal service
Observes inquiry opens, closes, validation failures and handoff outcomes
Attributes activity to the conversion rail, contact section, hero or page context
Explicitly excludes dates, guest count, names and stay descriptions from signal payloads
Persists no journey data in localStorage, sessionStorage or cookies
Exposes bounded aggregate snapshots for future reporting and diagnostics
Adds permanent regression coverage for privacy, signal contracts and inquiry instrumentation
manual_review: Open the inquiry from the desktop conversion rail and complete the mail handoff
Open the inquiry from the contact section and use Copy text
In the browser console, inspect CasaPublicJourneySignals.snapshot() and confirm only aggregate operational counters are present
Inspect CasaPublicJourneySignals.recent() and confirm no entered dates, names, guest counts or stay text are present
Confirm the visible inquiry experience is unchanged on desktop and Android
title: Privacy-Safe Journey Signals
test_focus: No personal data in signal payloads
